printer: Bambu Lab P1S, 0.4 mm stainless steel nozzle (stock)

parts.name: Plate post
parts.material_reason: outdoors in the sun; carries the turret

print.printer: Bambu Lab P1S, 0.4 mm stainless steel nozzle (stock)
print.orientation: upright: the flange on the plate

mates_with.dimensions: two M3 x 3 inserts 20 mm apart along x at each post position
M3 insert in the top end

fasteners.item: M3 x 8 socket head cap screw
fasteners.use: plate post flange to the deck inserts

notes: Print upright with five walls: the waist is the thinnest section, but the posts are fixed at both ends, so the bending moment from the plate swaying is smallest there.

parts.name: Post cable clip
parts.material_reason: flexes to snap on without cracking

print.printer: Bambu Lab P1S, 0.4 mm stainless steel nozzle (stock)
print.orientation: flat: the clip profile on the plate

mates_with.dimensions: 11.7 mm grip on the 12 mm post

notes: Snap onto the posts' thick sections (above or below the waist), ring facing inboard; one or two per post that carries cables.

parts.name: Turret plate (with the servo adapter mount)
parts.material_reason: the top of the car, in the sun

print.printer: Bambu Lab P1S, 0.4 mm stainless steel nozzle (stock)
print.orientation: upside down: the top face on the plate, adapter standoffs up

mates_with.dimensions: four M3 x 3 inserts on a 50 mm square
four M3 screws into the posts' top inserts
42 x 33 mm, dia. 2.5 holes on 37 x 28 mm
mates_with.source: Waveshare Bus Servo Adapter (A) product page (https://www.waveshare.com/bus-servo-adapter-a.htm), wiki (https://www.waveshare.com/wiki/Bus_Servo_Adapter_(A)) and schematic

inserts.where: pan base screws, from the top, through holes pressed flush

fasteners.item: M3 x 10 socket head cap screw
fasteners.use: turret plate onto the posts' top inserts

fasteners.item: M2 x 5 socket head cap screw
fasteners.use: Bus Servo Adapter (A) to the plate's standoffs
servo bus and camera cable at the plate's pass-throughs

notes: The turret's pan base bolts on with the same four M3 x 10 as on its own base plate.
The adapter hangs under the plate with its components down: set its jumper (A, UART) before fitting it.
